usedFor: Teams use 0codekit for file and data chores such as “Compress PDF” and “Redact Sensitive Data from PDF”.

bestTemplate.name: “Redact Sensitive Data from PDF” in 0codekit
bestTemplate.why: It removes names, addresses and other confidential data from a PDF and returns a redacted file or URL.

watchOut: “Run Async Python Code” delivers its result to a webhook URL, so have one ready to receive it.
